That is a loss with no error attached to it. A model vanishing from a menu
reads as a model that was never there, so the cost is paid every time by a
person retyping something they already configured — and it lands exactly
when they are out of quota and least able to spend time on it.
SO NOTHING WRITES THIS FILE. The server reads it and merges it with what
the SDK reports; no endpoint, no job and no agent edits it. Removing a
model is a deliberate act by a person, and a retired one keeps its entry
with a `retired` note rather than disappearing — see opus-5 when 5.1
arrives. rainsmoke3's golden-record gate refuses a write that drops an
entry, so an agent tidying this file is stopped rather than trusted.
